$comment: myAI kernel settings — dropped by `myai init` (greenfield) into a kernel-only repo's .claude/settings.json. Wires the PreToolUse SAFETY hooks (block-push-main, secret-scan, no-local-npm, protected-files) from the installed ai-management module, resolved at hook-exec time via `myai root`. The hook BODIES live in the module, never a per-repo copy (plan S-INIT-5, ADR-016 §0.5). Each command FAILS LOUD (exit 2 = block the tool) if the module is unresolvable, so a broken/missing install can never silently run this repo WITHOUT its safety rails. permissions.defaultMode=bypassPermissions matches the operator's standing config on every other repo — without it a fresh greenfield scaffold falls back to the user-level default (auto) and can't boot into bypass like the rest of the fleet (diagnosed 2026-08-02, exo).

hooks.command: _R="$(myai root 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -z "$_R" ]; then echo 'myAI module unresolvable — safety hook (block-push-main) cannot run. Reinstall: npm i -g ai-management' >&2; exit 2; fi; exec bash "$_R/hooks/pre-tool/01-block-push-main.sh"

_R="$(myai root 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -z "$_R" ]; then echo 'myAI module unresolvable — safety hook (secret-scan) cannot run. Reinstall: npm i -g ai-management' >&2; exit 2; fi; exec bash "$_R/hooks/pre-tool/03-secret-scan.sh"

_R="$(myai root 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -z "$_R" ]; then echo 'myAI module unresolvable — safety hook (no-local-npm) cannot run. Reinstall: npm i -g ai-management' >&2; exit 2; fi; exec bash "$_R/hooks/pre-tool/05-no-local-npm.sh"

_R="$(myai root 2>/dev/null)"; if [ -z "$_R" ]; then echo 'myAI module unresolvable — safety hook (protected-files) cannot run. Reinstall: npm i -g ai-management' >&2; exit 2; fi; exec bash "$_R/hooks/pre-tool/04-protected-files.sh"
c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *bin/myai.cjs*|*"myai "*|"myai") printf '\033[48;5;208;38;5;16m  myai ▸ %s  \033[0m\n' "$c";; esac; exit 0
t=$(jq -r '.tool_name // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$t" in mcp__myai__*) printf '\033[48;5;208;38;5;16m  myai ▸ %s  \033[0m\n' "${t#mcp__myai__}";; esac; exit 0
